inputs.site-name: Rio Grande National Forest – Dry Mixed Conifer
inputs.site-description: Workshop example for the San Luis Valley Wildfire Council and RiGHT. Dry mixed conifer ecosystems on the Rio Grande National Forest.
inputs.climate-scenario: Workshop assumption: warmer, drier conditions. Fire season length, mean peak ERC, mean summer temperature, and drought frequency/duration increase; relative humidity and snowpack/SWE decrease. These changes are expected to increase each fire regime characteristic (high severity patch size, fire frequency, soil burn severity, annual area burned).
